s21_direction_share.definition: share_dir(sigma_dir) = [D(0.5, sigma_dir) - D(0.5, closed_dir)] / D(0.5, sigma_dir), per object, on the dir sweep grid with the closed point (1e-3 deg, share = 0 by construction) prepended. r* = log10-linear interpolated sigma_dir at which share_dir FIRST reaches 0.02 scanning ascending (censored: "<0.1" if already above at 0.1 deg, ">25" if never). Outcome robust (C7 upgraded): median r* > 4 deg (beyond the original direction-grid max). Outcome artifact (C7 downgraded): median r* <= 1 deg (within the original grid). Otherwise scoped: report the per-object r* table and narrow C7 accordingly.
s21_direction_share.direction_only_note: direct C7 generalization: D(closed_logI, sigma_dir) over the sweep; the frozen measurement's max was 1.68%

s21_reverse_control.definition: share_int(sigma_logI) = [D(sigma_logI, 1 deg) - D(closed_logI, 1 deg)] / D(sigma_logI, 1 deg) at fixed sigma_dir = 1 deg (a physically plausible direction uncertainty): shows the intensity channel still carries the value when the direction channel is held at a fixed plausible size.

s22_two_term_law.definition: Per family point, rho_mean task (a = rho/||rho||, exactly gauge-aligned; the identity A a = B cbar is Sigma-independent -- recorded once per object as align_residual control): q = sum_{k active} Lambda0_k[0,0]/||rho||^2, r = ||rho||^2 / sum(rho^2 * finf), V_pred = (1 - 1/kappa)/(1 + q*r), V_meas = 1 - J_a(kappa)/J_a(1) via woodbury_quad_risk. Law robust: median |dV| <= 0.01 AND max |dV| <= 0.05 across ALL family points (frozen joint-parameterization reference: median 0.0008, max 0.039). Otherwise: the law's accuracy is parameterization-specific (report per-tier breakdown).
s22_two_term_law.align_note: gauge identity A·a = B·c̄ residual (Sigma-independent, computed once per object; A's identity part has zero family dependence by construction)

s23_ceiling.definition: Theorem (M10/M10'): D <= 1 - 1/kappa for any per-light Lambda0 ≻ 0 under the structural model -- ZERO Sigma-dependence. Recorded as a runtime GUARD (max violation over all rows must be <= 1e-9), NOT as experimental evidence; the docs statement is "the bound holds across the family".
